name: Pasar Thanksgiving Pererenan: A Neighbourhood Feast
description: Bringing together food, creativity and community, Pasar Thanksgiving Pererenan: A Neighbourhood Feast invites locals and visitors alike to gather at Noema Resort Pererenan on Saturday, 28 November 2026, for a day of food, music and creative activities. Taking place across the resort’s lobby and front yard from 2pm to 9pm , Pasar Thanksgiving Pererenan gathers local food and beverage brands, creative entrepreneurs, artisans and artists in a lively neighbourhood market setting . Visitors can explore food stalls from participating brands, including Noema’s own Mamaloma and Paparempa , alongside Nasgero, Snoo Donuts, Tample Somari and Mad Burger. At the heart of the celebration is The Gratitude Long Table , a communal dining experience where 100 guests will be invited to share a complimentary dinner. The gathering aims to bring people from different backgrounds together over a shared meal, celebrating the spirit of connection and togetherness.

name: Earth Company Presents Re: Bali 2026
description: On Saturday, 28 November 2026, Earth Company is set to host Re: Bali 2026 at venue partner Mana Earthly Paradise, Ubud. Themed “Inner to Outer Regeneration”, this year’s event will run from 12pm to 6pm. A social enterprise based in Bali and Japan, Earth Company aims to develop regenerative futures that holistically enhance planetary well-being through three programmes: Impact Heroes – an accelerator programme empowering unique changemakers from the Asia-Pacific in shaping regenerative futures; Impact Academy – a transformative experiential programme that empowers institutions, companies and schools to build regenerative futures; and Mana Earthly Paradise – an award-winning next-generation eco-villa in Ubud that embodies circularity and regeneration. Following its debut last year – which drew over 100 participants and more than 60 organisations and social enterprises – Re: Bali shifts its focus to the people driving the work. This edition asks what regeneration demands of the people and organisations working for the island. At Earth Company, regeneration starts within. Grounded, supported, and connected changemakers create lasting impact across their communities and Bali’s environment.

name: An Evening of Purpose & Possibility
location: Sofitel Bali Nusa Dua Beach Resort
description: A year after its inaugural charity gala helped fund a new school in Southwest Sumba, Sofitel Bali Nusa Dua Beach Resort is once again turning an evening of dining and celebration into an opportunity to give back. The resort will host its 2 nd Annual Charity Gala Dinner, An Evening of Purpose & Possibility, on 11 December 2026. Held from 6pm to 10pm at the Kecak Ballroom , the evening will bring together Bali’s hospitality and business communities, philanthropists, government representatives, media and influencers for a night of food, entertainment and purposeful giving. Last year’s gala, An Evening of Elegance & Empathy, raised IDR 500 million for Bali Life Foundation . The contribution helped fund a new school in Southwest Sumba, which was officially inaugurated in July 2026. Today, that school stands as a lasting reminder of what collective generosity can achieve.

name: Padma Musical Series: George Harliono & Hera Hyesang Park
description: The Padma Musical Series returns this December with an evening of classical music featuring two acclaimed international artists: British-Indonesian pianist George Harliono and Korean soprano Hera Hyesang Park. Returning to Bali following his previous appearance at Padma Resort Legian, Harliono has established an impressive international career from a remarkably young age. In 2023, he received the Silver Medal at the XVII International Tchaikovsky Competition, one of the most prestigious events in the classical music world. His performance history includes celebrated venues such as Wigmore Hall, Royal Albert Hall, Berlin Philharmonie Kammermusiksaal and Suntory Hall, alongside appearances with orchestras including the NHK Symphony Orchestra, Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra and Mariinsky Orchestra. Joining him for the December performance is Hera Hyesang Park, making her Bali debut. A Deutsche Grammophon recording artist and graduate of The Juilliard School, the Korean soprano has performed at leading opera houses and concert halls around the world, including the Metropolitan Opera, Staatsoper Berlin, Paris Opéra and Glyndebourne Festival. Her repertoire spans celebrated works including La bohème , La traviata , Don Giovanni and Le nozze di Figaro . Her debut album, I Am Hera , was released in 2020, followed by Breathe , which received the 2024 Opus Klassik Award for Videoclip of the Year.

name: Beautiverse 2026: Green Beauty for the Future of Wellbeing
description: From 18-20 December, Beautiverse 2026 returns to Bali, once again taking place at The Meru Sanur – Bali Beach Convention Centre, under the theme ‘Green Beauty for the Future of Wellbeing.’ This year, Beautiverse explores the evolution of the beauty industry towards a more holistic, conscious, and technology-driven approach. Over the three-day event, visitors can experience brand showcases, expert-led discussions, networking opportunities, and curated activities. The event also provides a platform for industry stakeholders to exchange ideas, build partnerships, and explore new opportunities across the beauty and wellness sectors. Featuring AI Ambassadors Tara, Bea, and Vexa as key highlights, Beautiverse introduces an innovative digital dimension to the experience. Beyond engaging audiences, these digital ambassadors reflect the growing relationship between artificial intelligence and the beauty and wellness industries. The Beautiverse App complements this initiative by providing information on the event, participating brands, programmes, and activities, creating a more interactive experience for visitors.
